displayAddress: Enclave: Birmingham City, 149 Hurst St Birmingham B5
description:
Enclave: Birmingham City offers an exclusive collection of 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom residences, blending contemporary design with premium finishes and smart layouts to create refined homes in the heart of Birmingham.
From day one, residents can enjoy curated amenities including a hotel-style lobby, landscaped garden, podcast studios, and 24/7 on-site team—plus exclusive early resident offers. As future phases open, even more will follow: a state-of-the-art gym, spa, yoga studio, music room, screening room, private dining, co-working lounges, and more. Together, they deliver an unrivalled lifestyle that redefines city living.
Ideal for sharers, young families, or anyone seeking more space, our two-bedroom homes are as versatile as they are elegant. Featuring two bathrooms, open-plan layouts, and winter gardens, these apartments are perfect for entertaining, working from home, or simply relaxing in comfort. High-spec finishes, SMEG appliances, and ultra-fast Wi-Fi come as standard, while flexible design options ensure your home feels as individual as you are. *These photos & floorplans show the layout & finish of an apartment in the development. The sizes, prices, layouts & finishes of each flat vary.
